description: The canalised Oust (Canal de Nantes à Brest): boats pass the river's weirs through the locks. At Limur OSM maps 60 m of the weir beside the lock but not its run across the main bed to the north; at La Maclais it maps no weir. Routes took the river round both locks. These weirs close it. Source: https://www.canaux-de-bretagne.org/ (Canal de Nantes à Brest, écluses de Limur and de la Maclais)
